scripts.text:
[Roel]
We're looking for adventurers that can join us for a brand new adventure. If you're at the Level to accept IGU's quests, then you're qualified.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我们正在寻找能够加入我们的冒险者，一起开启全新的冒险。如果您已达到可以接受IGU任务的等级，那么您就符合条件了。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I'm Roel, new member of the White Wings Guild. Roter had me search everywhere for Newoz, and I've found some clues as to his whereabouts.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我是罗埃尔，白翼公会的新成员。罗特让我到处寻找纽奥兹，我找到了一些关于他下落的线索。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Recruiting guild prospects! Join us in our search for our former master Newoz! Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
正在招募公会成员！加入我们，一起寻找我们曾经的师父纽奥兹！您有兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
What a difficult task. I searched from this end to that end of the world, and could find neither hide nor hair of him.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
真是艰巨的任务。我搜遍了世界的每一个角落，却连他的影子都没找到。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I tried to some trace of him, but to no avail.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我试图追踪他的踪迹，但毫无结果。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Newoz is an avid adventurer who never stays in one place long enough; a lot of people claimed they saw him, yet none of them remembered where he went.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
纽奥兹是一位热衷冒险的人，他从不长久停留在一个地方。很多人声称见过他，但没人记得他去了哪里。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
After a while, I had to give up on tracing him. I was just wasting time.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
过了一段时间，我不得不放弃追踪他。那只是在浪费时间。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I turned my eyes to the Other World, and there I met some eyewitnesses. They led me to the last place Newoz had been seen.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我将目光投向了异世界，在那里我遇到了一些目击者。他们指引我找到了纽奥兹最后出现的地方。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
The whole process was painful. If it weren't for Runane, we couldn't have Memorized his last location or gotten out of it.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
整个过程很痛苦。如果不是露娜恩，我们无法记住他最后的位置，也无法脱身。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
If you're interested in joining us, please talk to Runane. We have an exciting adventure ahead of us.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
如果您有兴趣加入我们，请去和露娜恩谈谈。我们前方有一段令人兴奋的冒险。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
If you're interested in joining us, please talk to Runane.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
如果您有兴趣加入我们，请去和露娜恩谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
It was my first adventure as a member of White Wings. I can't wait for the next one!
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
这是我作为白翼公会成员的第一次冒险。我迫不及待想要迎接下一次冒险了！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Where do you think Shaloshi is by now? The space where we met Shaloshi is caught in a time loop, repeating the same events again and again.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
您觉得沙洛希现在在哪里？我们遇见沙洛希的那个空间陷入了时间循环，同样的事件不断重复。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Mingmin thinks the phenomenon has something to do with the Dimensional Crack and Shaloshi's ability.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
明敏认为这种现象与次元裂缝以及沙洛希的能力有关。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I didn't quite understand her, but Runane said the portal to the place she Memorized is based on time instead of space.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我没太听懂她的意思，但露娜恩说通往她记住的那个地方的传送门是基于时间而非空间的。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
If you want, you can go back in time and experience the same events. Do you want to embark on an adventure again?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
如果您愿意，可以回到过去，体验同样的事件。您想再次踏上冒险之旅吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
You might have a different experience this time in this place full of unfathomable mysteries. Please ask Runane to open the portal for you.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
在这个充满不可思议之谜的地方，您这次可能会有不同的体验。请让露娜恩为您打开传送门。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
This time, maybe you don't have to leave Shaloshi.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
这一次，也许您不必离开沙洛希了。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Are you ready yet? You can give up if you're not confident.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
您准备好了吗？如果您没有信心，也可以放弃。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Roel]
That's the spirit!
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
这就对了！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Adventuring is always fun. Be a great adventurer, okay?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
冒险总是充满乐趣的。
要成为伟大的冒险者哦。

^ff0000如果您想使用我的次元传送门，首先必须与罗埃尔交谈。传送门并非对所有人开放。^000000

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Our adventure hasn't started yet, and I'm already hungry.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我们的冒险还没开始，我就已经饿了。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
It seems everyone's here.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
看来大家都到齐了。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
I told you, Newoz. We can't just let this go.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
我告诉过你，纽奥兹。我们不能就这样算了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Considering the time and money we wasted on you, you deserve to be fed a basket full of poisonous mushrooms.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
考虑到我们为你浪费的时间和金钱，你值得被喂一篮子毒蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I'll explain everything. And enough with the poisonous mushrooms. I can't eat mushrooms at all.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我会解释一切的。还有，别再提毒蘑菇了。我根本不能吃蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Newoz, you can't eat anything but meat. Sigh, I'm glad you're safe.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
纽奥兹，你只能吃肉。唉，很高兴你平安无事。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
You're the famous Newoz! Nice to meet you. My master told me many great things...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你就是著名的纽奥兹！很高兴见到你。我的师父跟我说过很多关于你的好事...

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Enough. He's just an idiot with no sense of direction.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
够了。他只是一个没有方向感的笨蛋。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Wow, Newoz! Your eyes look puffier than ever.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
哇，纽奥兹！你的眼睛看起来比以往更肿了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Hello, Arang. How's Arirang? Heh. What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你好，阿朗。阿里朗怎么样了？呵。是什么风把你吹到这里来了？

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Newoz, do you know how long you've been missing? We even recruited new guildsmen to find you, and...
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
纽奥兹，你知道你失踪多久了吗？我们甚至招募了新的公会成员来找你，而且...

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Hi, nice to meet you. I'm honored to meet the famous Newoz in person.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
你好，很高兴见到你。能亲眼见到著名的纽奥兹，我感到很荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
H-hello, my name is Roel. Runane and I've joined the guild together. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
你...你好，我叫罗埃尔。我和露娜恩一起加入了公会。很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
In accordance with the Guild Policy, Article 8, I'm now the master of this guild, and you're just a member.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
根据公会政策第8条，我现在是公会的师父，而你只是一个成员。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Oh, congratulations, Master.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哦，恭喜，师父。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
...That wasn't what I expected. Aren't you upset at all?
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
...这不是我预期的反应。你一点都不生气吗？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
What did you expect? All he thinks about is adventure, monsters, and treasure.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
你期待什么？他满脑子想的只有冒险、魔物和宝物。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Argh, is there a ghost? Or am I hearing things?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
啊，有幽灵吗？还是我听错了？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
...
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
...

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Whew, it's you Jack. Long time, no see, everyone.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
呼，原来是杰克啊。好久不见了，各位。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
This isn't a good time for chit-chat. I'm sensing something from the very floor where you're standing and where I'm hiding.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
现在不是闲聊的时候。我感觉到你脚下和我躲藏的地方有什么不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Jack, is that why you're hiding like a coward?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
杰克，你像胆小鬼一样躲起来是因为这个吗？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
It comes natural for veteran thieves like me to hide themselves in potential enemy territories.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
像我这样的老练盗贼，在潜在的敌对区域隐藏自己可是本能。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I'm not hiding because my sprite is not yet ready!
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
我躲起来不是因为我的模型还没准备好！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I agree with Jack. Everything about this place--from the air to the soil--screams unnatural.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我同意杰克的看法。这个地方的一切——从空气到土壤——都透着不自然。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
Could it be supernatural?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
难道是超自然现象？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Or otherworldly.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
或者是来自异世界的东西。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
...

[Newoz]
You're Lagi, right? I like the way you think. I'd love to work with you sometime.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你是拉吉吧？我喜欢你的思维方式。希望以后能有机会与你合作。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I've joined this guild to meet you, Newoz. Do you have a girlfriend?
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我加入这个公会就是为了见到你，纽奥兹。你有女朋友吗？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Don't you dare--I called dibs on him first!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
别想——我先说好的！

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I don't think he knows that. Do you, Newoz?
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我觉得他应该不知道吧。纽奥兹，是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Well, I didn't...
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
呃，我并没有...

scripts.text:
[Runane]
*Snort* Then he's fair game!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
*哼* 那他就是名正言顺的猎物了！

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Um, the conversation seems to have gone...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
呃，话题好像有点...

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
She can change subjects more quickly than an Arclouse can cast Increase AGI.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
她转换话题的速度比阿库罗斯施放敏捷提升术还快。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Are they competing over Newoz? I want in, too!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
她们是在争抢纽奥兹吗？我也要加入！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
...Sorry to bother you guys, but I think something's over there.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
...抱歉打扰大家，我觉得那边有什么东西。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Perhaps it's monsters. Do you want me to go check?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
也许是魔物。需要我去查看一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Runane]
You stay here, kiddo. I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
你留在这里，小鬼。我去。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Wait, we're not finished here!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
等等，我们还没聊完呢！

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
Oh, both of them left.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
哦，她们两个都走了。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Newoz, you're like a magnet for crazy.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
纽奥兹，你就像个疯狂磁铁。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
I can see what has made you become so irritable, Master.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我明白了，师父，这就是您变得如此易怒的原因。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
He's born irritable.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
他天生脾气就暴躁。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Agreed. He's violent, dirty...
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
同意。他既暴力又邋遢...

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Oh, shut it, both of you!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
哦，你们两个都闭嘴！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
That reminds me, when Rot was younger...
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
这让我想起，罗特小时候...

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Rot? Is that your pet name, Master? Are you two friends?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
罗特？那是师父的绰号吗？你们两个是朋友？

scripts.text:
[Roter]
That does it! I'm leaving!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
够了！我要走了！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
That Crack thing, or the entrance as you might call it, has vanished. If you really want to leave, then follow Aigu.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那个裂缝，或者说是入口，已经消失了。如果你真的想走，那就跟着艾古吧。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Stop pretending you care about me! I can take care of myself!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
别假装关心我！我能照顾好自己！

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Master, come with me!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
师父，跟我走吧！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh, we've got new members, huh? Great, I have a few mushrooms that I've wanted to sample...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哦，有新成员了？太好了，我有几种蘑菇一直想尝尝...

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
Roel, I think we should move too.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
罗埃尔，我觉得我们也该出发了。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
走吧。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Arang, let's go. It's time for an adventure!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
阿朗，走吧。是时候去冒险了！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
All righty!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
好嘞！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I hope there are lots of things to study.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
希望有很多东西可以研究。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
...
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
...

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
...
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
...

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Let's move before they forget about us.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
趁他们还没忘了我们，赶紧走吧。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I'm Roel, new guildsman. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我是罗埃尔，新加入的公会成员。很高兴认识你。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Stop bothering me. Can't you see I'm hiding?!
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
别烦我。你没看见我在隐匿吗？！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Heya!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
嗨！

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
I've followed Aigu all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我一直跟着艾古走到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
You look new around here. Nice to meet ya!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你看起来是新来的。很高兴认识你！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
He's bad news. Trouble follows him wherever he goes.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
他是个麻烦精。走到哪里都跟着麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Oh, is he the famous Newoz?
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
哦，他就是著名的纽奥兹？

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
This place gives me the heebie-jeebies.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
这个地方让我毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
...We finally meet, Newoz!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
...终于见面了，纽奥兹！

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Please, let there be no more surprises.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
拜托，不要再有意外了。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Um, I have a feeling something might spring out of nowhere to attack us.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
嗯，我有一种预感，好像有什么东西会突然从不知哪里跳出来攻击我们。

scripts.text:
[???]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[???]
那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Runane]
*Shriek*
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
*尖叫*

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
MONSTER-! ...Um, it's just a woman.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
魔物-！...呃，只是个女人。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
There's something! SOMETHING!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
有东西！有东西啊！

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Calm down. It's just a woman.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
冷静点。只是个女人。

scripts.text:
[???]
Voice of a woman...

[Aigu]
How did we get in, you asked?
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你问我们是怎么进来的？

scripts.text:
[???]
No idea. How did you get in?
scripts.translation:
[???]
不知道。你们是怎么进来的？

scripts.text:
[Runane]
We got lost and now we're in a rift in spacetime. How did this happen?
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我们迷路了，现在被困在时空裂缝里。这是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
We didn't have to be here if it weren't for someone.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
如果不是因为某个人，我们根本不需要在这里。

scripts.text:
[???]
The one who sings.
scripts.translation:
[???]
那个唱歌的人。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Do you know Newoz? Let's take him out of here.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
你认识纽奥兹吗？我们把他带出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Okay. Take my hand.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
好的。握住我的手。

scripts.text:
[???]
Your hand is ... warm.
scripts.translation:
[???]
你的手...很温暖。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
It's calloused because I dance. Heh heh.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
因为跳舞磨出了茧。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Where's everyone? Have they gone somewhere else? Let's go in that direction.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
大家都不在吗？
他们去别的地方了吗？
我们往那个方向走吧。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
A place full of mysteries.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
一个充满神秘的地方。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
These monsters are boring.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
这些魔物真无聊。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
I'm detecting electromagnetic waves up ahead. At least Grade E monsters.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我检测到前方有电磁波。
至少是E级魔物。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Hey, what have you been reading these days?
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
嘿，你最近在读什么书？

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Heh, Sci-Fi. There's a mechanical tool that works...
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
嘿嘿，科幻。
里面有一种机械工具，可以...

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Stop talking and get ready to practice your special skills.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
别废话了，准备练习你的特殊技能。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Ooh, this will be like reenacting a scene from the book, where monsters are rampaging.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
噢，这就像重现书里的场景，
魔物正在肆虐。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Gelka, Ultra Special Skill No. 8: Wild Dance!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
盖尔卡，超特殊技能第8式：狂野之舞！

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
!!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
!!

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Here we go!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
来了！

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Delicate Flashlight, Lumiere Dupleix!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
精致闪光，双联光束！

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Ruinous Twelve Heaven's Nets!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
毁灭十二天网！

scripts.text:
[Gelka/Roter]
CROSS!!!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡／罗特]
交叉！！！

scripts.text:
[Gelka/Roter]
Scatter--Thousand Flashlights!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡／罗特]
散射——千束闪光！

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
...Whew.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
...呼。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Hm, not good enough, Gelka. Don't let the guild business distract you from practice.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
嗯，还不够好，盖尔卡。
别让公会事务分散了你练习的精力。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Yes, Master!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
是的，师父！

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Where are the others? This is definitely not a run-of-the-mill cave.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
其他人呢？
这绝对不是一般的洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Something might jump us!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
可能有东西会袭击我们！

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text: Did you get lost by yourself again?
scripts.translation: 你又一个人迷路了吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
I'm not alone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我不孤单。

scripts.text:
[???]
Aigu and Runane are good.
scripts.translation:
[???]
艾古和露娜恩很好。

scripts.text:
[???]
Ask many questions.
scripts.translation:
[???]
问了很多问题。

scripts.text:
[???]
Can't answer.
scripts.translation:
[???]
答不上来。

scripts.text:
[???]
Can't remember a thing.
scripts.translation:
[???]
什么都不记得。

scripts.text:
[???]
But I'm not alone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
但我不孤单。

scripts.text: Leave him.
scripts.translation: 丢下他。

scripts.text: It's too dangerous, so take him with you.
scripts.translation: 太危险了，带他一起走。

scripts.text:
[???]
I'm okay. Not the first time.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我没事。不是第一次了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Kind.

[Newoz]
I'll sing again later.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我稍后再唱。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Newoz! Where did you go this time?
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
纽奥兹！这次你又去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Sorry.
This place is like a maze. There are so many offshoots and clearings that I've lost count.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
抱歉。
这里像个迷宫。岔路和空地太多了，我都数不清了。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
*Snort* You said the same thing about the Prontera Culvert.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
*哼* 你在普隆德拉下水道也说过同样的话。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
What are you talking about? Why can't you just follow us? Where's Runane? I saw her next to me a moment ago.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你在说什么？为什么不能跟着我们？露娜恩呢？刚才我还看见她在我旁边。

scripts.text:
[???]
Man with the singing voice.
scripts.translation:
[???]
唱歌好听的男人。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Oh, hello. May I ask who you are, little lady?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哦，你好。请问你是哪位，小女士？

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
I'm Shaloshi. Sing for me.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我是沙洛希。为我唱首歌吧。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Hah hah, you're cute. I'll sing for you later.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哈哈，你真可爱。我稍后为你唱。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
You promised. You're kind.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
你答应过我的。你人真好。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Monsters started appearing, and their number is growing quickly.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
魔物开始出现了，而且数量增加得很快。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You'll be okay, Aigu, so long as you stick with us... Um, where's everyone?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
艾古，只要跟着我们就没事的……嗯，大家呢？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Hah hah, don't worry, little ladies. I'll protect you.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哈哈，别担心，女士们。我会保护你们的。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Newoz, I love you!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
纽奥兹，我爱你！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
You protect me. You're kind.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
你保护我。你人真好。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
You'd run before everyone else in here. Well, we can't stay here. Let's move on.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你肯定比这里所有人都先跑掉。总之，我们不能留在这里。走吧。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Monsters started appearing, and their number is growing quickly.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
魔物开始出现了，而且数量增加得很快。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
...

[Arang]
I'm not scared!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
我才不怕！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
What's wrong with me? My heart won't stop pounding.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我怎么了？我的心跳个不停。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
The fog cleared up.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
雾散了。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
But it stayed long enough for us to lose each other.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
但雾停留的时间足够让我们走散了。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
One moment, I had Shaloshi's hand in my hand, and the next, she's gone.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
刚才我还牵着沙洛希的手，一转眼她就不见了。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Her name is Shaloshi? I asked her several times, and she didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
她叫沙洛希？我问了她好几次，她都没告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
That's strange. She told Newoz straight from the start.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
真奇怪。她一开始就告诉纽奥兹了。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Hmpf, I hate girls. I get the feeling we'll be seeing even more monsters.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
哼，我讨厌女孩。感觉接下来会出现更多的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Worry not--I'll protect you!
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
别担心——我会保护你的！

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
You'd better be more reliable than someone I know.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你最好比我认识的那个家伙靠谱点。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Don't put too much faith in this kid. I'd better go look for Newoz.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
别太信任这个小孩。我得去找找纽奥兹。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
...

[Roel]
(She's just my type!)
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
（她正是我的菜！）

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Where do you think Newoz is this time?
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
你觉得纽奥兹这次会在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I feel great--this is my first adventure in a long time since I was charged with caring for other adventurers. Plus I've met my hero Newoz!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
感觉棒极了——自从我负责照顾其他冒险者以来，这是很久以来的第一次冒险了。而且我还见到了我的英雄纽奥兹！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Everything about her screams suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
她浑身上下都透着可疑。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Newoz!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
纽奥兹！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Yeah, what's up?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
嗯，怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Do you really have to ask? Who's that girl? Is she yours?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你还要问吗？那个女孩是谁？是你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
W-whazza...?! Don't be ridiculous. I just found her now.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
什...什么？！别开玩笑了。我刚刚才遇到她的。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
A little girl in this strange place, by herself? Hm, doesn't it sound strange to you?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
一个小女孩独自出现在这个奇怪的地方？嗯，你不觉得这很奇怪吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
You're strange.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
你才奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
No, I'm not! You don't want me to get angry at you, girl.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
不，我不奇怪！你不想让我对你发火吧，女孩。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Here they come...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
它们来了...

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
These monsters don't stop coming. But where are all the big, rare, beautiful ones?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
这些魔物没完没了地涌来。但是那些体型巨大、稀有又美丽的魔物都在哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I'll have to study you later, girl.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我之后要好好研究一下你，女孩。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
...

[Shaloshi]
Newoz's hand... hot.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
纽奥兹的手...很热。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I wonder what might wait for us at the end of this passage. The anticipation is killing me!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
不知道这条通道的尽头会有什么在等着我们。这种期待感快把我逼疯了！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I always love singing.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我总是喜欢唱歌。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I keep losing the others. They were right in front of me.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我总是弄丢其他人。明明就在眼前。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
We've met again.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我们又见面了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
You have good taste. This just came to my mind. Listen.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你的品味不错。这首歌刚好浮现在脑海中。听好了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
The seasons are changing once again~ yet I haven't had a chance to dye my nails with garden balsam~
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
季节又要更替了~ 可我还没机会用花园香膏染指甲呢~

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
Waiting for snow~
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
在等雪落~

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
You're good. You'll make great a Gypsy and Minstrel.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你很棒。你会成为出色的冷艳舞姬和宫廷乐师。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
I want to stay as a Bard for a while.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我想先当一会儿诗人。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I guess jobs don't matter so long as you can sing and play, huh?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
看来只要会唱歌演奏，职业并不重要，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Love your song.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
喜欢你的歌。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Shaloshi, do you have a favorite song?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
沙洛希，你有喜欢的歌吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Runane sings even whistles good, too.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
露娜恩唱歌好听，口哨也吹得好。

scripts.text: - Shaloshi puckers her lips to whistle, but fails. -
scripts.translation: - 沙洛希嘟起嘴想吹口哨，但失败了。 -

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
Um, are you trying to whistle?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
那个，你是在尝试吹口哨吗？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Hah hah, I'll teach you how to do it later, Shaloshi.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哈哈，以后我教你怎么吹，沙洛希。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
{0}, do you have a favorite song?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
{0}，你有喜欢的歌吗？

scripts.text: Aigu's debut song- Lost Poring
scripts.translation: 艾古的出道曲 - 丢失的波利

scripts.text: Aigu's single- Only I Didn't Know about the Card Album
scripts.translation: 艾古的单曲 - 只有我不知道的卡片专辑

scripts.text: Newoz's Red Potion (feat. Muka)
scripts.translation: 纽奥兹的红色药水 (feat. 摩卡)

scripts.text: Laggi's Self-composed song- Accidental Moonlight
scripts.translation: 拉吉的自作曲 - 意外的月光

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
You know her debut song. You're a fan of her, huh?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你知道她的出道曲。你是她的粉丝，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Aigu is the Rune-Midgarts' hottest singer at this moment!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
艾古是卢恩·米德加兹目前最红的歌手！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Hah hah, this is embarassing, but thank you.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哈哈，这有点尴尬，但谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
But how...?! It's not released yet.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
但是...怎么知道的？！那首歌还没发行。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Hm, to each his own.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
嗯，各人有各人的看法。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
Something else is showing up.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
还有别的东西出现了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Ah, I'm getting hungry. The monsters can screw themselves. Shaloshi, let's go!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
啊，我饿了。那些魔物让它们自便吧。沙洛希，我们走！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Okay.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
好的。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
Hey, come with me!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
嘿，跟我来！

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
I'm not experienced in adventuring, but it's quite fun.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我虽然没什么冒险经验，但还挺有趣的。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
(Trying to whistle) I can't.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
（试图吹口哨）我吹不出来。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
These guys are different. They seem to understand music... or maybe not.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
这些家伙不一样。它们似乎能听懂音乐...或者也许没有。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Did you take care of them already? I wanted to take part in it!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你已经处理好了吗？我想参与进去的！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
They look cute, but they're ferocious.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
它们看起来很可爱，但很凶猛。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Small friends follow us. Not cute.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
小跟班跟着我们。不可爱。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
They're monsters, not your friends. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
它们是魔物，不是你的朋友。小心点。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Monsters...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
魔物...

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Could she have lost her memory? It seems she doesn't understand danger, it seems.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
她是不是失忆了？看起来她似乎不明白什么是危险。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Danger, no.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
危险，没有。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I think she has.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我觉得她确实失忆了。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
...

[Shaloshi]
It's not dangerous. Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
不危险。别担心。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I've trained enough. I can be useful.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我已经训练得足够多了。我可以派上用场。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Never let your guard down while exploring, or you can get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
探索时千万不要掉以轻心，否则可能会受伤。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Arang, why aren't you drinking it?
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
阿朗，你为什么不喝呢？

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Push, push~
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
推呀，推呀~

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Push, push~
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
推呀，推呀~

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
How long do I have to shimmy my shoulders~
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
肩膀要一直扭呀扭~

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Pam, pam, pam~
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
啪，啪，啪~

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Chica, chica~
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
擦，擦，擦~

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Pam, pam, pam, pam~
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
啪，啪，啪，啪~

scripts.text:
[Runane]
*Blow*
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
*吹气*

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Ugh, I don't want to drink this!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
呜，我不想喝这个！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Just trust me and drink it!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
相信我，快喝下去！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
What are you trying to feed this child? What's in this green bottle? ...No...
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
你们想给这孩子喂什么？这绿色瓶子里装的是什么？...不...

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Green Potion
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
绿色药水

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Green Potion is such a bitter... Um, Green Potion you said?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
绿色药水是很苦的... 呃，你说绿色药水？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Green Potion!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
绿色药水！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Green Potion?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
绿色药水？

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I said Green Potion!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我说了是绿色药水！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
But you're singing a strange song, and... Green Potion?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
可是你们在唱一首奇怪的歌，而且... 绿色药水？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I had an almost expired Green Potion, so we decided to play Rock-paper-scissors and feed it to the loser.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我有一瓶快过期的绿色药水，所以我们决定玩石头剪刀布，输的人喝掉它。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It doesn't do anything when you're not poisoned. We just didn't want to waste a good potion.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
没中毒的时候喝了也没用。我们只是不想浪费一瓶好药水。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
But it's awfully bitter.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
但是它真的很苦。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Are you drinking it yet?
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
你喝了吗？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
DRINK! DRINK!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
喝！喝！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
DRINK! DRINK!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
喝！喝！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Roel, can't you drink it for your sister?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
罗埃尔，你不能替姐姐喝吗？

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Let me go look for possible threats.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
让我去查看一下是否有潜在的威胁。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
A stream of water has started flowing.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
有一股水流开始流动了。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Hate Green Potions~
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
讨厌绿色药水~

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
How long do I have to shimmy my shoulders~
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
肩膀要一直扭呀扭~

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Hm, getting pretty awkward here.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
嗯，情况变得有点尴尬了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Some scholars have proved the drop of rate of Poring card is.. percent.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
有些学者已经证明，波利卡片的掉落率是..%。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I'm glad the mushroom is not poisonous.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
很高兴这蘑菇没有毒。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Its interior looked like that of a forest, then changed to that of a cave. How strange.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
它的内部看起来像森林，然后又变成了洞穴的样子。真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Strange plants growing on stranger terrains. Everything looks out of place.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
奇怪的植物生长在更奇怪的地形上。一切都显得格格不入。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I've harvested a few mushrooms to taste.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我采了一些蘑菇尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This mushroom is poisonous, but not life threatening. Do you want to have a bite?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
这蘑菇有毒，但不会致命。你想咬一口吗？

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text: Have a bite.
scripts.translation: 咬一口

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I won't take no for an answer!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我不接受拒绝！

scripts.text: - Mingmin shoves a mushroom into your mouth. -
scripts.translation: - 明敏把蘑菇塞进了你的嘴里。 -

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Hm?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You're not reacting. Maybe the mushroom is not poisonous after all. Maybe I should try one...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你没有任何反应。也许这蘑菇其实没有毒。也许我该试一个...

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Hm...

[Mingmin]
It has almost no taste.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
它几乎没什么味道。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Sheesh, this was a waste of time. You should go first. There's one more thing I want to look at.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
真是浪费时间。你先去吧，我还有样东西想看看。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You're braver than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你比我想象的还要勇敢。

scripts.text: - You feel good, possibly a side effect of eating the mushroom. -
scripts.translation: - 你感觉良好，可能是吃了蘑菇后的副作用。 -

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I should try one.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我也应该试一个。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Hm...

[Mingmin]
It has almost no taste.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
它几乎没什么味道。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Sheesh, this was a waste of time. You should go first. There's one more thing I want to look at.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
真是浪费时间。你先去吧，我还有样东西想看看。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Suddenly I crave meat. I should have brought a container full of it!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我突然想吃肉了。要是带了一大罐就好了！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
You made it sound so difficult, when you could just say, 'give and take.'
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你把它说得那么困难，其实只要说“有来有往”就行了。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Um, how did I manage to lose the others again?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
呃，我又是怎么把其他人弄丢的？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Newoz.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
纽奥兹。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Wah! Jeez!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哇！天哪！

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
And I thought you'd have gotten used to having me around invisible.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
我还以为你已经习惯我隐形跟着你了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Are we still in danger?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我们现在还危险吗？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Guess so. We've been circling around the same place, by the way.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
看来是的。顺便说一句，我们一直在同一个地方打转。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
So I was right about this place being maze-like. Ugh, I'm getting hungry again.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
所以我说这个地方像迷宫一样是对的。唉，我又饿了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I've waited for you because I wanted to talk.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
我等你是因为我想和你谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Newoz, your contract has expired at the time you returned to the guild.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
纽奥兹，当你回到公会时，你的契约已经到期了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Oh, that's right. Since I'm no longer the master, my contract has expired naturally.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哦，对。既然我不再是主人了，契约自然也就到期了。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
But given the situation, my promise to you still stands.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
但考虑到目前的情况，我对你的承诺依然有效。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Thanks. I'm glad my contingency plan is still in place.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
谢谢。很高兴我的备用计划还在。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Hmpf, just know I'm keeping my promise to you only because you've got what I want.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
哼，你要知道，我之所以信守承诺，只是因为你身上有我想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Oh, do you mean this ukulele?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哦，你是指这把尤克里里吗？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You moron, that's worth nothing. Your contract has expired, but a promise is a promise and I intend to keep it.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
你这个笨蛋，那东西一文不值。虽然你的契约已经到期了，但承诺就是承诺，我打算信守它。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Please don't talk to me--I'm hiding for a reason.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
请不要跟我说话——我躲在这里是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
It's possible someone else might be in here.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
可能还有其他人也在里面。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
I remembered a few things.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我想起了几件事。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Did you?
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
是吗？

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
She said she did.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
她说她想起了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Right, that's what she said.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
对，她是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Lagi & Newoz]
!!!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉与纽奥兹]
!!!

scripts.text:
[Lagi & Newoz]
Gimmie five!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉与纽奥兹]
击掌庆祝！

scripts.text: - *Slap* -
- Before the two give each other a high five, Aigu and Mingmin slap them on their backs. -
scripts.translation: - 就在两人准备击掌庆祝时，艾古和明敏拍了一下他们的后背。 -

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Stop goofing around. Shaloshi, talk to us.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
别闹了。沙洛希，跟我们说说吧。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
In the pitch darkness, I heard a voice. It was low, but it was ringing for a while.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
在漆黑的黑暗中，我听到了一个声音。声音低沉，但回荡了很久。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Later I heard Newoz singing while waiting for his friends. His voice warmed me.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
后来我听到纽奥兹在等待朋友时唱歌。他的声音温暖了我。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You speak like a grown-up now, all smooth and clear.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你现在说话像个大人了，流畅又清晰。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
She could have been terrified.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
她当时可能很害怕。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
I didn't know what friends meant, but it sounded good. I wanted it.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我不知道朋友是什么意思，但听起来很好。我想要它。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Aigu and Runane showed up.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
艾古和露娜恩出现了。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
I thought someone made my wish come true.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我以为有人实现了我的愿望。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
The pitch darkness... Don't you remember anything else?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
那片漆黑...你不记得其他事情了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
No.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
不记得。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
She could have had her eyes closed. Perhaps she's sleeping.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
她可能只是闭着眼睛。也许她在睡觉。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
The pitch darkness... The cave is bright throughout, aside from the fog.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
那片漆黑...除了雾气，洞穴里到处都很明亮。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
A dream. A low voice in a dream. What kind of dream?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
一个梦。梦里的低沉声音。是什么样的梦？

scripts.text: She heard her own thoughts.
scripts.translation: 她听到了自己的心声。

scripts.text: She was talking with someone.
scripts.translation: 她在和某人说话。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
...

[Aigu]
She may have not remembered everything, but this is an improvement. Let's wait until she's ready to talk more.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
她可能没有全部想起来，但这已经是进步了。等她准备好再说吧。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
A voice before my singing. It's possible someone else might be in here.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
在我唱歌之前有个声音。可能还有别人在这里。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
We'll know soon enough.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
很快就会知道了。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
I think someone made my wish come true.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我觉得有人实现了我的愿望。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
If you find my joke funny, don't try to hide it. Just laugh.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
如果你觉得我的笑话好笑，就别藏着了。直接笑出来吧。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Don't listen to him. He doesn't need encouragement for his bad jokes.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
别听他的。他那些烂笑话不需要鼓励。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I hope Shaloshi will recover her memory soon.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
希望沙洛希能尽快恢复记忆。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Ugh, I'm tired. Looking out for these new members all day is work in itself.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
唉，我累了。整天照顾这些新成员本身就很辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I miss the delectable combination of beef and acorns called Bifrost Roast Beef.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我怀念那种牛肉和橡果的美味组合，叫做双层牛肉堡。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Don't worry. Children grow by fighting.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
别担心。孩子们是在战斗中成长的。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Arang! Shaloshi!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
阿朗！沙洛希！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
What?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Weren't you in danger?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你们刚才不是遇到危险了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Where have you been? We just had an awesome monster here!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你们去哪了？我们刚才遇到了一只很厉害的魔物！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Heh, my instincts told me to slow down because danger was ahead.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
嘿嘿，我的直觉告诉我前方有危险，所以放慢了脚步。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Oh, the instincts of a great adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
哦，真是伟大冒险者的直觉啊！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
No, his adventurer instincts have gotten rusty.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
不，他的冒险者直觉已经生锈了。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
He's just being lazy. He's not so weak.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
他只是太懒散了。他并不弱。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
My instincts just told me Newoz is not strong.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我的直觉告诉我，纽奥兹并不强。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Newoz, did you just think everyone except Rot is mediocre?
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
纽奥兹，你刚才是不是觉得除了罗特以外的人都很平庸？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
You can talk and you can hear other people's thoughts. Brilliant.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你既能说话，又能听到别人的想法。真厉害。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Enough! Stop being disrespectful to Newoz!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
够了！不要对纽奥兹无礼！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Comrades should not fight with each other.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
同志之间不应该互相争斗。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Comrades should not fight with each other. Got it.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
同志之间不应该互相争斗。知道了。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Comrades, who? We're just a bunch of strangers hell-bent on saving a lost girl!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
同志？我们只是一群一心想要拯救迷路女孩的陌生人！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
(She's hawt when she's angry!)
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
（她生气的时候好可爱！）

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
We'll talk again the moment we're out of here.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
等我们离开这里，再好好谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Don't care.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我才不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
I never slack on my training.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我从不在训练上偷懒。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Can't you hear what others think?
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
你听不到别人的想法吗？

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Yap! Yap!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
叽叽！叽叽！

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I bake and knit in my spare time. I'm very domestic. Ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我空闲时会烘焙和织毛衣。我很擅长家务。呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Roter]
It's true that I'm the strongest.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
我确实是最强的。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Comrades should be best friends!
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
同志之间应该是最好的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Wait, I've collected some Autumn Leaves and Blue Cards to give to other friends as souvenirs. Where are they?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
等等，我收集了一些落叶和蓝卡，想送给其他朋友作为纪念。它们在哪里？

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Having you two with me brings back a lot of memories.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
有你们两个在我身边，让我想起了很多往事。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
I was as stubborn as a mule and busy pretending like I knew what I was doing.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
我当时像头倔驴一样，还拼命装作自己很懂的样子。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Do you remember when you two fought over that florist girl at the southern gate of Prontera? Or when the doll merchant at the eastern gate whupped you for bickering and driving his customers away?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你们还记得在普隆德拉南门，为了那个花店老板吵得不可开交吗？或者东门那个玩偶商人，因为你们吵架吓跑了顾客，狠狠教训了你们一顿？

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Do you not have any good memories of us?
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
难道你们就没有关于我们的美好回忆吗？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Oh, I remember! Ah, good times!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
哦，我想起来了！啊，那是段美好的时光！

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Am I the only one not happy about this conversation?
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
难道只有我对这段对话感到不快吗？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
How about when you played with Dead Branch to death? Or when you and your Sorcerer buddies killed yourselves playing Hocus Pocus?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
还有那次，你们把枯树枝玩到死？或者你和你的妖术师伙伴们玩“变戏法”把自己玩死了？

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Can't you think of a nice memory?
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
就不能想点美好的回忆吗？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I can! Mingmin drank the Poison Bottle I found on the street and died; I told you it was expensive, and I didn't say anything about it being good for your health.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我可以！明敏喝了我从街上捡到的[非卖品]毒药瓶然后死了；我明明告诉过你它很贵，而且我没说它对健康有益。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh, I remember! That was funny!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哦，我想起来了！那真有趣！

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Argh!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
啊！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Tsk, tsk. I practically raised everyone here, and now they're at each other's throughts over the guild master position.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
啧，啧。我几乎把这里的人都带大了，现在他们却因为公会长的职位互相敌视。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Don't let yourself be deluded by rumors! I'm the Stag of the Southern Gate, the most powerful Bishop in exorcist history!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
别被谣言迷惑了！我是南门的雄鹿，驱魔史上最强力的主教！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Friends... Rivalry... Comrades...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
朋友...竞争...同志...

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Maybe Newoz is not interested in dating.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
也许纽奥兹对谈恋爱不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Tell me something I don't know.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
告诉我点我不知道的事。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
But you haven't tried to talk to him. I mean seriously, have you?
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
但你还没试着和他谈谈。我是说，认真点，你试过吗？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
You've met him today, but you should know unless you're stupid.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你今天见过他了，除非你是笨蛋，否则你应该知道。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I know--he'll say no if I ask him out.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我知道——如果我邀请他，他一定会拒绝的。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
That dimwit is only interested in adventuring.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
那个笨蛋只对冒险感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Don't call my hero that! ...But I agree with you.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
别那样称呼我的英雄！...不过我同意你的看法。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
You seem to be fond of Roel.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你似乎很喜欢罗埃尔。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I'm not interested in that kid.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我对那个小孩没兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
How about you, Adventurer? How are things with your significant other?
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
那你呢，冒险者？你和你的另一半过得怎么样？

scripts.text: You don't even know if I have one.
scripts.translation: 你甚至不知道我有没有另一半。

scripts.text: My love is unrequited.
scripts.translation: 我的爱是无望的单恋。

scripts.text: We're happy.
scripts.translation: 我们很幸福。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm on the verge of bursting into tears.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
哦，抱歉，我快要哭出来了。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Unrequited love is painful. You'd better let it go before it breaks you.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
单恋很痛苦。你最好放手，否则它会毁了你。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Are you serious? Even people like you have found their love. What about me?!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
你是认真的吗？连你这样的人都能找到真爱。那我呢？！

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I don't mind healthy rivalry, but I prefer friendship, however long it lasts.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我不介意健康的竞争，但我更希望我们能保持友谊，无论多久。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Let's make a truce for now. But make no mistake--Newoz is mine the moment I find him vulnerable.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我们先休战吧。但别误会——一旦纽奥兹露出破绽，他就是我的了。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
(Friends... Rivalry...)
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
(朋友...竞争...)

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Over my dead body!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
除非我死了！

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Let's make a truce for now. But make no mistake--Newoz is mine the moment I find him vulnerable.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我们先休战吧。但别误会——一旦纽奥兹露出破绽，他就是我的了。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I don't mind healthy rivalry, but I prefer friendship, however long it lasts.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我不介意健康的竞争，但我更希望我们能保持友谊，无论多久。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Ferres don't bite me.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
费雷不会咬我。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Roel and Runane are hurt.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
罗埃尔和露娜恩受伤了。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I'm fine. I told you to be careful, kiddo!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我没事。我让你小心点，小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Sorry. I won't disappoint you again.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
对不起。我不会再让你失望了。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
She's not happy with him, but she still treats him really well.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
她虽然对他不满意，但对他还是很照顾的。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
(She's kind!)
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
（她真好！）

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Don't mistake this for anything more than what it is--babysitting!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
别想多了，这不过是看孩子而已！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
She's blushing.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
她脸红了。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
There's nothing about you I like.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我对你没有任何好感。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Before Aigu and Runane,
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
在艾古和露娜恩之前，

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
The Ferres showed up first.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
费雷们先出现了。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Ferre?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
费雷？

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
They emit 'ferre, ferre,' so I call them Ferres.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
它们会发出“费雷、费雷”的声音，所以我就叫它们费雷。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
They did nothing but croaked.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
它们只会呱呱叫。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
They're my friends. They don't bite or hurt me.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
它们是我的朋友。它们不会咬我，也不会伤害我。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
But now...
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
但现在...

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Listen, humans and monsters can't be friends. At least that's what I think.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
听着，人类和魔物不可能成为朋友。至少我是这么认为的。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Can't be friends.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
不可能成为朋友。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
That's right. I like you better when you listen to me.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
没错。你听我的话，我才会更喜欢你。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
How about I be your friend?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
那我可以做你的朋友吗？

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Stop making things awkward! We're about the same age, so we're friends already.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
别搞得这么尴尬！我们年纪差不多，本来就是朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
(Can't be friends.)
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
（不可能成为朋友。）

scripts.text:
[Runane]
True friends don't need to declare their friendship; they just become friends without knowing.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
真正的朋友不需要宣告友谊；他们不知不觉间就成了朋友。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I'm okay. At least I can protect Shaloshi. Feeling protective of someone is nice.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我没事。至少我能保护沙洛希。保护别人的感觉真好。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
We should find her.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我们应该去找她。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Strange... The atmosphere has changed.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
奇怪... 气氛变了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The air smells different, and things look less... perceptible.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
空气的味道变了，周围的事物看起来也变得不那么... 清晰了。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
It seems as though we're underwater, yet I don't feel it.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
感觉好像在水下，但我并没有这种感觉。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I'm telling you, we've been circling around the same place.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
我告诉你们，我们一直在同一个地方打转。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I agree. And this clearing is neither compact nor spacious.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我同意。而且这片空地既不算紧凑，也不算宽敞。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Do you think it's meaningless for us to go deeper?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你们觉得继续深入没有意义吗？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
No. I'm just saying the environmental changes are too drastic, almost like the mood swings of a bipolar person.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
不。我只是说环境变化太剧烈了，简直像双相情感障碍患者的情绪波动一样。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I don't know why, but things are losing their shape as if they're fading away.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我不知道为什么，但事物正在失去形状，仿佛正在消失。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
All the while, the foreign energy I've been sensing is growing stronger. This is bad.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
一直以来，我感知到的那股外来能量正在变强。这很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I feel like something's going to appear in front of our eyes with a loud pop.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我感觉有什么东西会伴随着巨大的声响突然出现在我们眼前。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
I hope it's a formidable monster!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
我希望那是一只强大的魔物！

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I hope you're wrong.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我希望你是错的。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
I'm just going to leave you guys to...
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我就把你们丢在这里...

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
The monster?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
魔物？

scripts.text:
[Roter]
I'll kill you both before the monster.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
在魔物出现之前，我会先杀了你们两个。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Master, please!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
师父，请！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Have you seen Shaloshi? Where is she?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你们看到沙洛希了吗？她在哪？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Oh, you're right!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
哦，你说得对！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
...

[Melody-Jack]
...
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
...

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
We should find her.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我们应该去找她。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Newoz is never tactful.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
纽奥兹从来都不懂得委婉。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
I have a feeling Newoz is up to no good.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
我有一种预感，纽奥兹又要搞事情了。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
We'd better look for an exit before things get too crazy.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
在情况变得太混乱之前，我们最好先找个出口。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Newoz's enthusiasm for adventure went overboard. Again. I can't say I hate that about him, though.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
纽奥兹对冒险的热情总是过火。又是这样。不过，我不得不承认，我并不讨厌他这一点。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
I wish these monsters were as cute and helpless as those Porings for the Taekwon mission.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
我真希望这些魔物能像太拳任务里的那些波利一样，既可爱又无助。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
They're bickering all the time, but look like good friends. Don't they?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
他们总是吵吵闹闹的，但看起来像是好朋友。不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
I practice hard, so I can shine in times of danger.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我刻苦练习，以便在危险时刻能够大放异彩。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
One of my friends once set me up on a blind date in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我的一个朋友曾经在依斯鲁得岛给我介绍过相亲对象。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
She and I exchanged a couple of letters, first to introduce each other, and then the second to set up a date.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我们首先互寄了几封信来介绍彼此，然后第二封信是为了约定见面。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
She didn't reply to my second letter. I can't fAigure out why.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
她没有回复我的第二封信。我实在想不明白为什么。

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Scene 8: Heroes are surrounded by a horde of enemies. Roel, let's choreograph what we've practiced today, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
第八幕：英雄被一群敌人包围。盖尔卡，我们来演练一下今天练习的内容，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Gelka, get ready!
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
盖尔卡，准备就绪！

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Gelka-style Mental Strength! Iron Physique!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
盖尔卡式金刚不坏！铁壁身躯！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Impenetrable defense! Roel-style Guard!
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
坚不可摧的防御！罗埃尔式卫兵！

scripts.text:
[Roel & Gelka]
CROSS!!!
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔与盖尔卡]
交叉！！！

scripts.text:
[Roel & Gelka]
Last bastion!
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔与盖尔卡]
最后的堡垒！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
By the gods, Gelka, you're awesome!
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
天哪，盖尔卡，你太厉害了！

scripts.text: Awesome, indeed!
scripts.translation: 确实很厉害！

scripts.text: You just made up those words to look cool!
scripts.translation: 你只是随口编了这些词来耍帅吧！

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
I've learned from the best.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我是向最优秀的人学习的。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I hope you'll teach me too, Roter.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
罗特，我也希望你能教我。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Special skills are all about their names. Shouting impressive names is enough to intimidate your enemies.
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
特殊技能的关键在于名字。只要喊出威风的名字，就足以让敌人感到恐惧。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
You're a spoilsport, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
你真是个大煞风景的人，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Roel]
We've practiced hard.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我们很努力练习了。

scripts.text: - They're absorbed in talking about their new special skills. -
scripts.translation: - 他们正兴致勃勃地讨论着新的特殊技能。 -

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Fighting is essential to adventurer training. Divide and conquer!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
战斗是冒险者训练的基础。各个击破！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Shaloshi...
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
沙洛希...

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Hurry.
scripts.translation: 快点

scripts.text: Try to jog your memory while hurrying.
scripts.translation: 一边赶路一边试着回忆一下。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
...

[Melody-Jack]
I'm afraid this place is falling down around us.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
恐怕这个地方快要塌了。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
The Ferres are angry.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
费雷们很生气。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Wow, you can even hear what monsters think?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哇，你甚至能听到魔物在想什么？

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
They're my friends.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
它们是我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
No, they're not. Friends don't attack each other!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
不，它们不是。朋友之间不会互相攻击！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
They're just trying to protect me.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
它们只是想保护我。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Protect you from what?
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
保护你免受什么伤害？

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
From what Rot is thinking.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
免受罗特想法的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
...
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
...

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Ferre?
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
费雷？

scripts.text:
[Ferre]
Ferre, ferre!
scripts.translation:
[费雷]
费雷，费雷！

scripts.text:
[Ferre]
Ferre, ferre, ferre!
scripts.translation:
[费雷]
费雷，费雷，费雷！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
!!!

[Roter]
We're going to be buried in here. Let's find an exit.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
我们要被埋在这里了。快找出口。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
We have to find Shaloshi!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我们必须找到沙洛希！

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Newoz, I've known you're weird in the head, but she's...
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
纽奥兹，我知道你脑子有点不正常，但她...

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I know. You don't have to remind me.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我知道。不用你提醒我。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Then let's get out of here. We're in serious danger right now.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
那我们赶紧离开这里。我们现在处境非常危险。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I have to find her. I have to talk to her.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我必须找到她。我必须和她谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
NEWOZ!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
纽奥兹！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I'm not your master anymore. You don't have to follow me.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我不再是你的师父了。你不必跟着我。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
!!!

[Aigu]
Newoz, I'm coming with you!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
纽奥兹，我和你一起去！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
It's your call, new master.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
这是你的决定，新师父。

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
Master!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
师父！

scripts.text:
[Roter]
...

[Roter]
We'll find Newoz and Shaloshi. And when we do, I'm going to kill both of them.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
我们会找到纽奥兹和沙洛希。等找到他们，我会把他们都杀掉。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Newoz, did you know this would happen? You're lucky to have such good friends.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
纽奥兹，你知道会发生这种事吗？你真幸运，有这么多好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
He didn't know because he doesn't think, ever.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
他不知道，因为他从来都不动脑子。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Yippee! Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
耶！出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Roter]
We'll split into two teams. Be careful not to lose your way in the maze-like offshoots.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
我们分成两组。小心别在迷宫般的岔路里迷路了。

scripts.text: Follow Roter and Gelka.
scripts.translation: 跟随罗特和盖尔卡

scripts.text: Search alone.
scripts.translation: 独自搜索

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Are we ready? Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
准备好了吗？出发！

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I knew this would happen, and Aigu didn't listen to me!
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
我就知道会发生这种事，艾古却不听我的！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Haap!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
哈普！

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
I believe in you, Master!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我相信你，师父！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
*Grunt* Why did I get myself into this mess?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
*哼* 我怎么会陷入这种麻烦？

scripts.text:
[Runane]
We should find Newoz and Shaloshi first.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我们应该先找到纽奥兹和沙洛希。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I'll follow you guys to the ends of the world.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我会追随你们到天涯海角。

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
I hope today won't be the last day I play my instrument...
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
希望今天不是我演奏乐器的最后一天...

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I'm following Newoz.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我跟着纽奥兹。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
I'll show you my charismatic leadership as the guild master!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
我要向你们展示我作为公会会长的魅力领导力！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
*Pant Pant* I'm glad you didn't make it too far.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
*喘气* 很高兴你们没有走太远。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
*Pant Pant* I've found you, Shaloshi.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
*喘气* 我找到你了，沙洛希。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Newoz...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
纽奥兹...

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
*Pant Pant* I'm glad you didn't make it too far.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
*喘气* 很高兴你们没有走太远。

scripts.text:
[Ferre]
Ferre, ferre, fe-!
scripts.translation:
[费雷]
费雷，费雷，费-！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Ferre is angry.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
费雷生气了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
You don't have to get upset. I'm not here to take your friend away. I just want...
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
你不用这么激动。我不是来带走你的朋友的。我只是想...

scripts.text:
[Ferre]
Ferre, ferre, ferre!
scripts.translation:
[费雷]
费雷，费雷，费雷！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Ferre is really angry.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
费雷真的很生气。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Yeah, you don't have to tell me that.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
是啊，不用你说我也知道。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
This is not good. Ferre...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
情况不妙。费雷...

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
No, no!
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
不，不！

scripts.text:
[Ferre]
Ferre, ferre, ferre, ferre-!
scripts.translation:
[费雷]
费雷，费雷，费雷，费雷-！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Ferre has transformed into its true form!
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
费雷变回了它的真身！

scripts.text: ^FF0000A formidable enemy has appeared!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000强大的敌人出现了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Ferre]
FERRE- FERRE- FERRE- FERRE-!!
scripts.translation:
[费雷]
费雷- 费雷- 费雷- 费雷-！！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Ferre, you don't have to do this!
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
费雷，你不用这样的！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Well, if I can't talk him out of this, then we'll have to duke it out.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
既然劝不住他，那就只能打一架了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Where are the others? Hey new guys, help me out here. That Ferre looks like he can pack a punch.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
其他人呢？嘿，新来的家伙们，帮个忙。那个费雷看起来很有力气。

scripts.text:
[Ferre]
FERRE, FERRE, FERRE-!
scripts.translation:
[费雷]
费雷，费雷，费雷-！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Shaloshi..
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
沙洛希...

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I like his spirit, though I can see he's getting exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
虽然我很欣赏他的斗志，但看得出他已经精疲力竭了。

scripts.text:
[Ferre]
Ferre...
scripts.translation:
[费雷]
费雷...

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Newoz, you're alive! Good, because I'm going to kill...
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
纽奥兹，你还活着！很好，因为我要杀...

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Newoz, are you all right?
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
纽奥兹，你没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
I'm all right. Rot, were you worried about me?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
我没事。罗特，你是在担心我吗？

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Wow, this place is not going to last long--look how violently the ground is shaking! We really need to get out like yesterday, Newoz.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
哇，这个地方撑不了多久了——看地面震动得多厉害！纽奥兹，我们真的得像昨天那样赶紧离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Ferre]
Ferre...
scripts.translation:
[费雷]
费雷...

scripts.text:
[Roter]
He's not dead. Guys, I understand you're new, but you can't make mistakes like this.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
他没死。各位，我知道你们是新人，但不能犯这种错误。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Better get rid of him quickly.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
最好快点解决他。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
NO! He's my friend!
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
不！他是我的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Ferre created this space in the Crack for me. If he loses his mind or perishes, this space will disappear with everything in it.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
费雷在裂缝中为我创造了这个空间。如果他失去理智或死亡，这个空间连同里面的一切都会消失。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Except you, you mean.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
除了你之外，对吧。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
...

[Roter]
I should have plenty of time before that to get rid of you. I'll show you why I'm called the Bad Boy of the Exorcist World.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
在那之前我有足够的时间解决你。我会让你看看，为什么我被称为驱魔世界的坏男孩。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
If I take Ferre with me to a different space, then a number of exits will appear in the loosened rift in spacetime.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
如果我带着费雷去另一个空间，时空裂缝中就会出现许多出口。

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
You're smart and capable of teleportation. Roter, we can't let her go.
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
你很聪明，而且拥有瞬间移动的能力。罗特，我们不能放她走。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
I shouldn't have led you here, but I really wanted some friends.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我不该带你们来这里，但我真的很想要一些朋友。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
And you have them. Us.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
现在你有了。就是我们。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
...Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
...谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Now I should be honest with you. I remember everything now. Let me introduce myself again.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
现在，我应该对你们诚实了。我现在全都想起来了。让我重新介绍一下自己。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
I'm Shaloshi, a demon mind reader and the third agent of Morocc's.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我是沙洛希，一名恶魔读心者，也是莫罗克的第三特工。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
MOROCC?!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
莫罗克？！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
...I'm free now, but that doesn't change who I am: a demon.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
...我现在自由了，但这改变不了我的本质：我是一名恶魔。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
I enjoyed your company. If we meet again... Will we be enemies?
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我很享受与你们相处的时光。如果我们再次相遇...我们会成为敌人吗？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
No, Shaloshi. As of today, you're a new member of Newoz's White Wings Guild.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
不，沙洛希。从今天起，你是纽奥兹白翼公会的新成员了。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Who says you can invite her? I'm not taking in a demon!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
谁允许你邀请她了？我才不会收留一个恶魔！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Guildsmen can bicker with each other, but they're still family.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
公会成员之间可以争吵，但大家终究是一家人。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
...Thank you, Adventurer Newoz. If I find some interesting place, can I invite you over?
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
...谢谢你，冒险者纽奥兹。如果我找到有趣的地方，可以邀请你们过来吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
I think I have the ability to take people with me, wherever I go. Or you wouldn't have followed me this far.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
我想我有能力带着别人一起走，无论我去哪里。否则你们也不会跟到这里。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Don't you dare take away my Newoz!
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
你休想带走我的纽奥兹！

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
You just thought, 'take me, too!'
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
你刚才心里想的是“带上我！”

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
Aww, Runane. You're cute!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
哎呀，露娜恩。你真可爱！

scripts.text:
[Roel]
Shaloshi, I don't care who you are. You're my friend, and I'm yours.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
沙洛希，我不在乎你是谁。你是我的朋友，我也是你的。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Thank you. If only I knew how to express my feelings...
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
谢谢。要是我知道该怎么表达我的感情就好了...

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
It's easy. Just smile.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
很简单。只要微笑就好。

scripts.text:
[Shaloshi]
Bye, friends. I hope we'll meet again soon.
scripts.translation:
[沙洛希]
再见，朋友们。希望我们很快能再见面。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
Bye.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
再见。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Don't look at me. Is that an exit?
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
别看我。那是出口吗？

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
It's been a while since I had so much fun.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
好久没有这么开心过了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
This was my first adventure with my old friends in a long time. I hope we can do this again soon.
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
这是很久以来，我第一次和老朋友们一起冒险。希望我们很快能再这样玩一次。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Newoz. Need I remind you this guild is no longer called Newoz's White Wings?
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
纽奥兹。需要我提醒你吗？这个公会已经不叫“纽奥兹的白翼”了。

scripts.text:
[Newoz]
What? Did you change the guild name?
scripts.translation:
[纽奥兹]
什么？你们改了公会名字？

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Of course! Now it's called... Um...
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
当然！现在它叫... 呃...

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Stop thinking and just keep the old name.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
别想了，就保留原来的名字吧。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Nope, I'm going to call it Roter's Super Critical Guild!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
不行，我要叫它“罗特的超级暴击公会”！

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
...

[Aigu]
That sounds lame.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
听起来很土。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I'm not a fan of it.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我不喜欢这个名字。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
Dorky.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
好蠢。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
I'm the guild master! I name it whatever I want!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
我是公会长！我想叫什么就叫什么！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Not cool.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
不酷。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Keep the name. I'm out.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
保留原名。我退出了。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
You can't do that!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
你不能这样！

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
I'm not a member, but if you ask me, that name...
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
虽然我不是成员，但如果让我说的话，那个名字...

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
I'll never be able to speak that name. Aigu, are you sure you want to stick with these guys?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
我绝对无法说出那个名字。艾古，你确定还要和这群人混在一起吗？

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I don't care. I'm staying with Newoz.
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我不在乎。我要留在纽奥兹身边。

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I just don't like the name.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我只是不喜欢这个名字。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
Shush! We've had enough for a day. You all are dismissed! This concludes the adventure of Roter's Super Critical Guild!
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
嘘！今天到此为止。你们都解散吧！这就是罗特超级暴击公会的冒险故事！

scripts.text:
[Melody-Jack]
Our deal is done. Let me think about what I want in return...
scripts.translation:
[梅洛迪·杰克]
我们的交易完成了。让我想想想要什么作为回报...

scripts.text:
[Gelka]
I will! I'll practice harder, too!
scripts.translation:
[盖尔卡]
我会的！我也会更努力练习的！

scripts.text:
[Runane]
I want to go home. I really want to take a shower and eat some bread.
scripts.translation:
[露娜恩]
我想回家。我真的想洗个澡，吃点面包。

scripts.text:
[Roter]
You're a prospect for now. Work hard for the guild, and I might promote you one day.
scripts.translation:
[罗特]
你目前还是个预备成员。好好为公会效力，也许有一天我会提拔你。

scripts.text:
[Aigu]
I'll never again let you go, Newoz!
scripts.translation:
[艾古]
我再也不会让你离开了，纽奥兹！

scripts.text:
[Lagi]
I've found so much inspiration through this adventure. I'm hopeful I can write some good songs.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉]
这次冒险给了我很多灵感。希望能写出一些好歌。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Roel and I are friends now. Heh.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
我和罗埃尔现在是朋友了。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Roel]
I want to dance as well as Aigu.
scripts.translation:
[罗埃尔]
我想像艾古一样跳舞。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您现在携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I've stolen a few strands of hair from Shaloshi, thinking it'd come in handy someday. I want to analyze them, though I already know the results.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我从沙洛希那里偷了几缕头发，想着以后可能用得上。我想解析一下，虽然我已经知道结果了。

scripts.text: Strange Pendant
scripts.translation: 奇怪的坠饰

scripts.text: Jitterbug Tooth
scripts.translation: 吉特巴格之牙

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Have you seen this pendant?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你见过这个坠饰吗？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I think I can fit Pendant of Harmony and Pendant of Chaos together.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我觉得可以把和谐之坠和混沌之坠组合在一起。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
And if I do, the results will be incredible!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
如果做到了，结果将会不可思议！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
ATK +6%. MATK +6%. All stats +1.
Magic attacks from enemies cast Level 1 Auto Spell Maelstrom.
DEF: 0 Weight: 10 Required Level: 130
Slot: 1
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
ATK +6%。MATK +6%。全属性 +1。
敌人施放的魔法攻击会触发1级自动技能漩涡。
DEF: 0 重量: 10 需求等级: 130
插槽: 1

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
If my description of the combination results is strangely familiar to you, I wouldn't know. But that's how I picture the results. If you find both the pendants, bring them to me, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
如果你对我描述的组合结果感到莫名熟悉，那我不知道。但在我想象中结果就是这样。如果你找到了两个坠饰，请把它们带给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oooh, you've got some nice pendants. Do you want to combine them? It's failproof, I guarantee.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
哇哦，你有一对很不错的坠饰。你想把它们组合起来吗？保证不会失败，我向你保证。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Combine.
scripts.translation: 组合

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
The combining process is really simple. I just place the Pendant of Harmony on the ground, then throw the Pendant of Chaos at it... like this!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
组合过程其实很简单。我只需把和谐之坠放在地上，然后把混沌之坠扔过去...就像这样！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Oh, did I fail?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
噢，我失败了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
*Chuckle* I was messing with you--it worked!
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
*轻笑* 我在逗你玩呢——成功了！

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Ah, combining items is fun.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
啊，组合物品真有趣。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Do you have Jitterbug Teeth?
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
你有颤音虫的牙齿吗？

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I can't tell you just yet, but they're useful to me. Bring them to me, and I'll give you some booty Newoz has hoarded in return.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我现在还不能告诉你，但它们对我很有用。把它们带给我，我会用纽奥兹囤积的战利品作为回报。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
What exactly am I offering? Gigantic Bow, Storm Bow, and ^FF0000other valuable things found in this space.^000000 If you want them, bring me at least 50 Jitterbug Teeth.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我具体提供什么呢？巨弓、风暴弓，以及^FF0000在这个空间中发现的其他珍贵物品。^000000如果你想要，请至少带给我50颗颤音虫的牙齿。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I'll exchange 50 Jitterbug Teeth with ^FF0000a random item.^000000
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
我会用50颗颤音虫的牙齿交换^FF0000一个随机物品。^000000

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Exchange 50.
scripts.translation: 交换50颗

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
I won't accept anything less than 50 Jitterbug Teeth.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
少于50颗颤音虫的牙齿我不接受。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
All right! Let me think about what I want to give you...
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
好的！让我想想想给你什么...

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
Enjoy your item. Bring more Jitterbug Teeth if you want more items.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
请享用你的物品。如果你想要更多物品，请带来更多颤音虫的牙齿。

scripts.text:
[Mingmin]
This place is still full of things to study.
scripts.translation:
[明敏]
这个地方还有很多值得研究的东西。
